description: This file is a React client component for the Next.js application that renders a page for displaying and editing an AI-generated persona draft. It fetches data from a backend API, processes the data, and presents it with UI components, including JSON preview and edit options.

methods.name: getBackendBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for backend API calls, defaulting to localhost if environment variable is not set.

methods.name: readError
methods.description: Reads and constructs an error message from a failed fetch response.

methods.name: isPersonaDraftV1
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object conforms to the PersonaDraftV1 schema.

methods.name: coerceStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into a sanitized array of strings.

methods.name: personaDataFromDraft
methods.description: Transforms a draft object into PersonaData format for UI display.

methods.name: extractPersonaDraft
methods.description: Extracts persona draft data from a flexible orchestration record.
